description: Odd (S-carrier) half Borel–Leroy(0.068) singularity location + even-half Gevrey-order determination (single higher order vs index-less).

data.verdict: PART 1 (odd S-carrier half): Borel–Leroy(s≈0.068) singularity ρ_odd = 0.016017886; nearest parameter-free candidate Vol/2pi=0.323066 is 95.0% off — NO clean constant at this precision, ρ_odd is an unresolved location (measurement only). PART 2 (parity Gevrey orders): at k=31 BOTH parities' local Gevrey γ are still DECREASING toward a common small value (even γ≈0.08475, odd γ≈0.07777, gap 0.00698) — consistent with a SINGLE small Gevrey order (~0.07–0.09) for the whole ladder, the even/odd distinction of #3861 softening as a finite-k estimator artifact rather than two genuinely-different fixed orders. Neither parity's γ is converged at k=31 — no single Gevrey order is CLAIMED. Scope-(a): ρ_odd is a singularity LOCATION not a c₃/S value; no c_k wired; no fit; no tier change.
